label: Bible Study
prompt: Preaching the kingdom of God, and teaching those things which concern the Lord Jesus Christ, with all _____, no man forbidding him.
verse: Preaching the kingdom of God, and teaching those things which concern the Lord Jesus Christ, with all confidence, no man forbidding him.
note: The last verse of Acts — Paul under house arrest in Rome, still preaching freely.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: There failed not ought of any good thing which the LORD had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to _____.
verse: There failed not ought of any good thing which the LORD had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to pass.
note: Joshua's report card for God: not one good thing He promised failed — all came to pass.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Now Hannah, she spake in her heart; only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard: therefore Eli thought she had been _____.
verse: Now Hannah, she spake in her heart; only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard: therefore Eli thought she had been drunken.
note: Hannah prayed so silently and earnestly that Eli assumed she'd been drinking — it was the opposite.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Now unto the King eternal, _____, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verse: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
note: Recalling his own past as a persecutor, Paul can't help himself — he breaks into praise mid-letter.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Blessed is he whose _____ is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
verse: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
note: David's song of forgiveness opens with a blessing on the one whose 'transgression' is forgiven. Paul quotes it in Romans 4:7.
